author: serafimcloud
name: pixel-fire-button
description: A CTA button that fills with molten pixel fire: a doom-fire simulation on a 3px canvas floods the face from the bottom, the flames bend toward your cursor on hover, and a press sends a burst through them. Lit and unlit states, a ghost variant, and an overlay slot for spinners or success icons. Inspired by the fire CTA on the Forge landing page by ui8.ai (ui8.ai/forge), rebuilt from scratch.
